news.html: Honored to receive a Gold Reviewer Award from ICML 2026, recognizing top reviewers based on area-chair ratings. The award includes complimentary registration.
Learning Randomized Reductions accepted as Spotlight paper at ICML 2026 — top 2.2% of 23,918 submissions. Joint work with Shafi Goldwasser (UC Berkeley) and Orr Paradise.

Fault Injection Attacks and Countermeasures on TinyML Algorithms received the Best Student Paper Award at IEEE HOST 2026. The ML countermeasure in this work partly relies on a property discovered in Learning Randomized Reductions — great to see RSRs hardening TinyML against fault injection attacks.
Amazon Bedrock Guardrails Automated Reasoning checks reach general availability — now delivering up to 99% verification accuracy to enterprise customers.

Defended my PhD in Computer Science at Yale: Learning Randomized Reductions for Security, Privacy, and Side-Channel Resilience. Thesis committee: Ruzica Piskac, Jakub Szefer, Shafi Goldwasser (Turing Award, 2012), Byron Cook (VP, AWS), Zhong Shao, and Scott J. Shapiro.
Quantum Circuit Reconstruction from Power Side-Channel Attacks on Quantum Computer Controllers appeared in IACR TCHES 2024. Joint work with Chuanqi Xu, Ruzica Piskac, and Jakub Szefer (Yale).
Received Yale CS Graduate Distinguished Teaching Award for 2023–2024.
